blocks.text: Upon detection of a new incident, whether from monitoring alerts or a user report, the first step is to create a new incident channel in Slack.
The on-call engineer must acknowledge the incident in PagerDuty within 5 minutes. This formally begins the response.
Next, the Incident Commander (IC) assesses the severity. Based on the assessment, they will decide whether to declare a major incident or proceed with standard investigation.
For major incidents (SEV-0, SEV-1), the IC must open a war room video call and post the link in the incident channel.
Legacy procedure (deprecated March 2026): All incidents required a manual ticket to be filed in Jira. This is no longer the case.
